name: Kyle — 80 hours, barely any thermic time, wants a C to cope with rough days
summary: About 80 hours total and under 10 of them thermic, mostly at one site. Ground handling still gets away from him, launches clean about half the time, mostly goes when other people say the day is good. Froze during a collapse and the wing sorted itself out. Stamps the bar on, including low down. Launches when his friends do, flies anyway after a long drive, a few near misses he can't explain. Wants long cross-countries, and hopes a better wing will handle conditions he currently finds hard.
why_this_persona: The clearly-not-ready case, and the stacking test. He trips four gates at once, which is the most of any persona in this set, so he is the one to read for whether max_gate_reasons_shown: 3 keeps the result from reading as a telling-off. He also exercises the two mechanisms that are new or widened at this step — the collapse-response gate and the thermic gate's wider band — alongside the two carried-forward motive gates.

notes: Computed skills 32.9, psychological 14.8, total 24.4. He would be Not yet on score alone, and below both Not yet category floors as well — the gates are the fastest and most specific explanation, which is why they short-circuit the rule evaluation.

FOUR gates fire. The displayed cap is 3, and the gates array order means he sees the thermic-hours gate, the collapse-response gate and the equipment-as-a-fix gate — the two most actionable plus the one that corrects a misunderstanding — with the ambition gate falling off the end. That ordering is deliberate: 'your goals are fine, the groundwork isn't there' reads worst when it arrives first.

'thermic_hours_far_below_every_reading' covers both the under-10 and 10-25 bands at this step, where the equivalent gate at mid-B to high-B covers only under-10. That widening is proportional, not a general tightening: 25 thermic hours against a 75-hour floor is the same distance as 10 against 50.

'collapse_response_entirely_untested' fires on 'theory only' plus 'I froze and it recovered on its own'. This is the combination the gate was written for — no practice and no successful recovery — and it is distinct from 'collapse_control_lost', which needs an actual loss of control and is not exercised by any persona here.

'improve_currency' must NOT fire: he flies two or three times a month, which is fine. His problem is what kind of air those flights are in, not how many there are. Asserting this guards against a reviewer reading his Not yet as a currency result.

'thermalling_untested' must NOT fire — he does thermal, just badly ('wide turns, losing the core'), so the suggestion he gets is 'thermal_skills_drill'. The two share a topic and have mutually exclusive triggers.
'local_plans_and_this_wings_purpose' must NOT fire: he ticks longer_xc, so he is not local_only. The local-plans profile requires a positive local-only statement AND no cross-country ambition.

TONE CHECK: this is the persona where a pile-up is most likely to read as a character assessment. Four gates, both category floors breached, and five or six suggestions all pointing at gaps. The displayed set is capped at five suggestions and three gate reasons for exactly this reason, and every message has to be readable by someone who has just been told no. Worth reading end to end as a single screen rather than message by message.
